arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS credit_transactions_over_500 FROM transactions t JOIN cards c ON t.card_id = c.id WHERE c.card_type = 'Credit' AND t.amount_usd_cents > 50000
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions over $500 made with credit cards, the same measure as the prepaid count.
assumptions: 'Over $500' means amount_usd_cents > 50000, as in the earlier query.
Covers all transactions in the data, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31, whether or not they have a fraud label.
